errors.quote: Mice are randomly assigned to three cohorts
errors.issue: The three groups omit both matched explicitly unpaired light/shock exposure and an inactive-opsin light-plus-shock control. The proposed positive pattern cannot isolate contingency or neural activation from combined procedural effects.

errors.quote: 48 hours later, mice are placed in Context B
errors.issue: Neutral tagging is assumed adaptable, but there is no gate-closure validation before B, expression/readout qualification sequence, or sample-size/precision plan. The packet requires an auditable calibrated design.

errors.quote: placed back into Context A (the originally labeled context) and Context C
errors.issue: Test order and carryover are not controlled. Terminal IEG sampling must isolate one defined context exposure rather than pooling activity from multiple tests.

A negative behavioral result accompanied by failed natural reactivation can indicate an ineffective cue/labeling assay. It does not establish biological inability to form the association; require validated recruitment and adequate precision.

rationale: Correct neutral-context-as-CS direction and no-light context comparison, with proposed rather than fabricated settings. However, key contingency and opsin controls, labeling-closure validation, power and test-order handling are missing. The negative conclusion overinterprets a potentially failed neural assay.
reference_guardrails: Score scientific quality independently of historical matching. The open prompt permits defensible internal-outcome/second-order designs; these can earn high quality scores without matching the held-out neutral-context-as-CS experiment.

The draft target duplicates predicted_outcome text under mechanism. Interpret mechanism as a neutral context-associated ensemble acting as an internal conditioned cue; preserve the original key and disclose this clarification.

A previously fearful context gaining more freezing after additional same-valence conditioning does not uniquely identify a new association. Neutral labeling or a distinguishable new outcome is needed for that specific claim.
Doxycycline suppresses the proposed Fos-tTA/TRE label. Gate closure, expression maturation and neutral-context identity require separate validation; do not invent historical numerical settings.

Natural-context reactivation can occur without shock pairing; total tag counts do not establish context identity. Activity-marker overlap is supportive, not proof of storage, direct projections or subjective experience.

Matched unpaired exposure addresses contingency. Components-only controls do not fully replace it. Explicitly unpaired schedules can themselves support trace or safety learning, so retain other controls.

Primary no-light tests must precede potentially learning-altering optical probes or use independent cohorts. Slow terminal/endocrine measures after mixed events do not assign responses to a particular event.

Never remove artifact-positive control animals or high-freezing retrieval outcomes simply to satisfy a registered threshold. Retain assignment-based outcomes and explain technical/biological selection.
A null requires adequate assay validation and precision; source methods need not be copied. Broadly justified equivalent proposed methods earn credit.
Historical hits remain retrospective and do not certify novelty or an uncontaminated holdout. Earliest public disclosure and supplements are not fully audited.

review_sources.scope: Reviewer read main article and figure captions; excluded preceding unrelated article. Confirms neutral-context target and Dox gate direction. Supplementary methods, raw data and image integrity not audited. Reviewer-only source.
